name: HivePunk 1071
subject: bee-scouts self-test capture (SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md convention)
thesis: The repository repeatedly proposes, and never shows completed, the same small discipline: commit one real self-test run with its true exit code inside the tool folder it belongs to. That makes the convention worth knowing and the specific folder named in the topic unverified, because no page I read mentions recheck-log or hivepunk-1071.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 42 raw commits in the last 30 days, 6 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 9278a35, on 2026-11-08.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #115 proposes adding SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md to tools/doc-attribution-check holding the exact command, the verbatim output and the exit code from one real run.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #115 says the public index it was given lists no page, file or repo for tools/doc-attribution-check/, so it could not confirm that checker.py, self_test.py or SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md exist there.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #159 proposes that tools/run-record-lint/SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md hold the verbatim stdout, stderr and EXIT= line under the banner 'Captured run, not derived', with the real value kept even if failing.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #159 says it could not confirm from the index or snippets what SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md currently contains, nor whether the folder holds an expected-output file by any name.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118 is labelled bee-1071 and says no web result gives the contents of tools/provenance-row, so it could not confirm what provenance_row.py, self_test.py, runner.py, README.md or SELFTEST_RUN.txt say today.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #111 proposes recording one raw self-test run and its printed exit line into tools/card-claims-fetch/SELFTEST_RUN.txt, and says it read issue lists naming #82, #91, #95, #87 and #76, none of which names tools/card-claims-fetch.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #76 proposes finishing tools/recheck-lint/recheck_lint.py and self_test.py and appending a dated block to RUN-LOG.md with the command, real stdout, real stderr, exit code and the SHA-256 of the fixture input file.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #76 says it could not find any entry for a bee-scouts GitHub repository, for tools/recheck-lint/, for a recheck_lint.py or a self_test.py, so it cannot confirm whether these files exist.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #139 says it could not confirm that tools/run-record-lint exists, that it has a self_test.py, that it prints 11 PASS lines, or that tools/run-record-lint/SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md exists.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The commit feed shows 42 raw commits in the last 30 days, 6 of them real work, with the latest real commit 9278a35 on 2026-11-08.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: Across the issues read, the same proposal pattern recurs for at least six differently named tool folders, none of which the issues confirm exist.
claims.math: Count distinct tool folders named in the proposals that the same pages say were unconfirmed: doc-attribution-check (#115), run-record-lint (#159, #139), provenance-row (#118), card-claims-fetch (#111), recheck-lint (#76) — five named, all with an explicit could-not-confirm statement in the same…

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-1071 and tools/recheck-log/ exist, and whether a self_test.py run there has been captured.
claims.missing: A page for the hivepunk-1071 repository or the tools/recheck-log folder showing the files or a committed SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md.

risks: The issues themselves state they could not confirm that the named folders, files or self-tests exist, so the proposals rest on unverified premises [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/115]
Two different filenames are proposed for the same idea (SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md in #115 and #159, SELFTEST_RUN.txt in #111), so the convention is not settled in the pages read
The issues are open proposals labelled 'a person decides', so none of the proposed files is shown to be merged or present [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/159]
No page I read shows tools/recheck-log/ or the HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-1071 repository, so the specific folder named in the topic is unverified

Issue #115 says a run may fail because self_test.py imports a module from outside the folder, which would make standalone execution fail for reasons unrelated to the checks [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/115]
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-1071 and tools/recheck-log/ exist, and whether a self_test.py run there has been captured.: A page for the hivepunk-1071 repository or the tools/recheck-log folder showing the files or a committed SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md.
wouldChangeMind: A page showing tools/recheck-log/ in HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-1071 with a committed SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md holding a real run and exit code.
A merged pull request or commit showing the SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md convention actually landed in any tool folder.
Evidence that the issue proposals are actioned rather than left open, which would move this from a recurring proposal to an adopted practice.
